project_type: Create React App (react-scripts 5.0.1), single-page ERP frontend
build_system: react-scripts (CRA). No TypeScript. No custom webpack config.
test_framework: Jest + React Testing Library via react-scripts test (no test files currently exist for pages)
test_command: npm run build -- --no-progress 2>&1 (build passes = no compile errors; no jest tests for pages)
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` from d:\Hasti\Airjet\frontend. A clean build (exit 0, no red error lines) is the verification gate. The dev server (`npm start`) can also be used to visually confirm messages render.
environment_constraints: Windows workspace. PowerShell shell. Do NOT run `npm start` (dev server) as a blocking command; use `npm run build` for verification instead.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Match existing code style: single quotes, no semicolons in some files (mixed), 2-space indent.
key_patterns: 1) API errors are surfaced via error.displayMessage (set in the axios interceptor in src/utils/api.js). 2) Two error display patterns exist: (a) toast.error(err.displayMessage || 'fallback') from useToast hook, (b) setError(err.displayMessage || 'fallback') rendered as inline JSX error spans. 3) Some pages use err.response?.data?.error as a first fallback before displayMessage. 4) validators.js uses V.* functions returning plain English strings already reasonably user-friendly. 5) The central errorMessages.js file should provide a lookup table of friendly messages and a getErrorMessage() helper that wraps err.displayMessage.
directory_structure: frontend/src/ contains: utils/ (api.js, validators.js, roles.js, useErpRecords.js, useWarranties.js), hooks/ (useToast.js, useConfirm.js), components/ (Toast.js, Modal.js, etc.), context/ (SearchContext.js, PermissionContext.js), pages/ (flat .js files + subdirs: accounts/, attendance/, payroll/, purchase/, sales/, service/, spareparts/, warehouse/)
